about.what: Per-country subscription prices for Switzerland and Austria, checked by hand-run scripts on official pricing pages and App Store In-App Purchase lists. Same format as docs/research/prices-mena-2026-11.json.
about.amounts: amountMinor is in the currency's minor unit (Rappen for CHF, cents for EUR). 1490 = 14.90. Prices are the regular price after any free trial or intro offer.

status.verified: Read today from the official page in 'source'. A plan we couldn't read clearly is left out of the row and the note says so.

about.taxes: Switzerland VAT 8.1%, Austria VAT 20%. Swiss and EU consumer prices are normally shown with VAT included. Apple's iCloud+ page says taxes are included for Switzerland and the Euro row; Oura's page says 'inkl. Steuern'. Netflix's help page says taxes may be charged on top. App Store prices include VAT.
about.serviceIds: Match plan-ref ids (scratchpad plan-ref.json, same ids as prices-2026-11.json).
about.method: Pages read with curl or Playwright (chromium) from a US cloud IP using the country URL (e.g. spotify.com/ch-de/premium, apple.com/chde/..., apple.com/at/...). JS-heavy pages (PlayStation, Xbox, Uber) were rendered. App Store lists read from apps.apple.com/{ch,at}/app/id{ID}?l=en-GB (Apple shows at most 10 items). Pages that pick the country from the visitor's IP (dazn.com, canva.com) couldn't be read for these countries.
